name: otelcol.processor.redaction

arguments.name: allow_all_keys
arguments.description: Allow all attribute keys. Disables the allowed_keys list.

arguments.name: allowed_keys
arguments.description: Allowed attribute keys. Keys not on the list are removed.

arguments.name: allowed_values
arguments.description: Regular expressions for values that the processor leaves unchanged, even when they also match blocked value patterns.

arguments.name: blocked_key_patterns
arguments.description: Regular expressions for attribute keys whose values are masked.

arguments.name: blocked_values
arguments.description: Regular expressions for value substrings that the processor masks after key filtering.

arguments.name: hash_function
arguments.description: Function used to hash redacted values instead of masking them with a fixed string.

arguments.name: hmac_key
arguments.description: Secret key used for HMAC hashing when hash_function is an HMAC variant.

arguments.name: ignored_key_patterns
arguments.description: Regular expressions for attribute keys that pass through unchanged.

arguments.name: ignored_keys
arguments.description: Attribute keys that pass through unchanged.

arguments.name: redact_all_types
arguments.description: Redact non-string attributes as well, by converting them to a string representation.

arguments.name: summary
arguments.description: Controls diagnostic attributes that describe redaction activity. Use debug or info to send diagnostics. Use silent or "" to suppress them.

blocks.description: Configures where to send received telemetry data.
